meta.name: Generate Image (MOSS-Image Base)
meta.licenseNote: MOSS-Image-Base is Apache-2.0 (OpenMOSS, 2026-10); the ComfyUI repack Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image is Apache-2.0; its Qwen3.5-9B text encoder is Apache-2.0. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native qir::moss) with the official pipeline's settings: Qwen3.5-9B's last hidden state for the prompt in its chat template with thinking on, 50 Euler steps on the shift-5 schedule snapped to the 1000-step training grid, CFG 3 whose negative branch is the empty prompt with DiT block 22 skipped, the FLUX.2 small decoder. Files from Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image (each may sit one subfolder deep) and Qwen3.5's tokenizer.json in text_encoders/qwen35_tokenizer/.
meta.creator: OpenMOSS
